Placing plants for a bed, the rest of the plan is dimmed in gray instead of washed in red, so the bed stands out as the bright, clear part of the plan. Its outline, and the red ring around a plant placed outside it, are as before.

A group of the same plant keeps its one name (“Creeping liriope ×12”) as you zoom out, all the way to where plants’ names are left off, instead of turning back into a stack of the same name, one for each plant.
A bed’s name is quieter: in a darker shade of the bed’s own color, under its plants, in the middle of the bed. With plants hidden in Layers, bed names show over everything, as before.
